resources.string: Is it safe to link my bank account?

Yes, we use a platform called Plaid that securely connects financial accounts to mobile and web applications. It serves as a trusted bridge, allowing you to safely share your bank data — the same technology used by PayPal, Airbnb, and Coinbase.
Fiscal can help with helping you save money and offer advice on your spending habits. By view your investments and bank transactions, it will conclude how to help you
Link your bank account so Fiscal can read your transactions, investments, loans, and credit card amounts. Tap the Link Bank account option on the options page up top
